Tarak Program

«Tarak Program is an open-source technology initiative founded and created by Taraknath Karan. It develops web applications, digital tools, and technology projects.»

Organization

- Name: Tarak Program
- Official website: https://tarakpro.netlify.app/
- Founder and creator: Taraknath Karan
- Founder portfolio: https://taraknath341.github.io/
- GitHub: https://github.com/taraknath341
- Type: Open-source technology initiative

About

- "About Tarak Program" (https://tarakpro.netlify.app/#/about): Information about Tarak Program, its creator, and its mission.

Projects

Tarak Program develops and maintains the following projects:

- Tarak Search
- Tarak Notes: A free online notepad where users can create, edit, and securely save notes with their accounts. It includes AI-assisted writing and translation features.
- Tarak AI
- Tarak Translate
- Fire Ludo
- Stone Paper Scissors
- QR Code Generator

The projects are accessible through the Projects section of the official website.

- "Projects / Home" (https://tarakpro.netlify.app/)
